_comment: BH-9912 deny layer for the iron guardrails. bin/agent-call.sh composes this into the guarded lanes (IRON_LAW_LANES) only when DENY_GUARDRAILS=1 (rows lib.deny-guardrails[.<project>].deny_guardrails, default 0), and passes the same specs to --disallowedTools. Every prefix has an rtk twin because the fleet rtk hook rewrites the command. Shapes a prefix cannot express (gh api merge calls, wrangler d1 --remote writes, pnpm/yarn/bun runner forms) are bin/iron-law-guard.sh family 8. tests/deny-guardrails.bh-9912-test.sh section D proves every spec here is also denied by the guard.
